Joint demo and solution brief for GTM
transcript:
Header: 2025-04-15 15:00 PDT | Duration: 52 minutes | Attendees: Alex Johnson (Redwood AE), Priya Kapoor (Redwood SE), Marcus Lee (CloudMall Head Partnerships), Sara Nguyen (CloudMall Platform Eng), Diego Ramos (CloudMall Security)

[00:00] Alex Johnson: ok hey everyone thanks for hopping on, um quick check sound good?
[00:10] Marcus Lee: yep good here, thanks Alex
[00:18] Priya Kapoor: hi all, Priya from Redwood, I'll run through the reference arch and the listing checklist
[00:25] Sara Nguyen: morning, gonna be the hands on engineer on our side so I'll ask the deep q's
[00:32] Diego Ramos: Diego here, security lead, I'll focus on compliance + KMS

[02:05] Alex Johnson: quick agenda: marketplace listing steps, reference arch for private deployments, SSO/KMS, and then demo + action items, sound ok?
[02:15] Marcus Lee: yep, want to make sure the marketplace listing mirrors our CloudMall branding and pricing tiers

[05:00] Priya Kapoor: ok jumping in, this is our suggested ref arch — there was a slide shared, link in chat: https://redwood.ai/partner-assets/cloudmall-refarch (note: placeholder)
[05:18] Priya Kapoor: so basically two options: Hosted integration via Redwood API for rapid GTM, or Private deployment (VPC) for enterprise customers — private has KMS + audit logging in control of CloudMall.
[05:40] Sara Nguyen: when you say KMS, are we talking Redwood-managed keys or customer-managed (HSM)? we prefer customer-managed in our contracts
[05:50] Priya Kapoor: right, we support both — can do bring-your-own-key via customer KMS, and we also support HSM integrations for on-prem, though the on-prem package has extra ops steps.
[06:12] Diego Ramos: um can you clarify encryption at rest — is there double-encryption or just single at rest under our KMS?
[06:20] Priya Kapoor: it's envelope encryption; Redwood stores encrypted model artifacts and payloads with keys wrapped by customer KMS when CMK is provided — I'll follow up with exact KMS flow diagram in the refarch doc.

[09:45] Alex Johnson: on the marketplace listing, we need assets: logos (SVG), 300-word description, pricing tiers, and a 2-min demo video, we can draft the first pass and send to you.
[09:58] Marcus Lee: perfect. Regarding pricing — do you support per-request metering for dedicated pools? we have customers who want committed monthly usage for predictable bills.
[10:10] Alex Johnson: yep Dedicated supports monthly commits; we can include an example SKU, and Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching to show cost per 1k tokens.

[14:30] Priya Kapoor: technical note: for private deployments we recommend enabling prefix KV caching on the Redwood runtime to reduce token egress. some customers call it "K-V cash" in speech, sorry bad joke.
[14:47] Sara Nguyen: haha, yes that's important; our workloads are short-chatty sessions so cache hit rate is key. how do you handle model rollouts? can we pin model versions?
[15:05] Priya Kapoor: yes — you can pin model versions per route and we support canary rollouts with auto-fallback; we also provide per-route latency and cost dashboards in Redwood Console.

[19:00] Diego Ramos: on audit logs, does Redwood expose immutable event logs for inference requests? we need them for SOC2 evidence.
[19:12] Priya Kapoor: we expose request-level logs and structured traces, they can be exported to your SIEM or retained in the private control plane; retention policies are configurable.
[19:35] Diego Ramos: and SSO? we use Okta.
[19:40] Alex Johnson: we support SAML 2.0 SSO and SCIM for provisioning, Okta is a standard integration; we'll share the SAML metadata file.

[22:50] Marcus Lee: on the joint solution / gtM, can we co-brand the marketplace tile and have a joint solution brief?
[23:00] Alex Johnson: absolutely — we usually do co-branded one-pager and a 'how it works' diagram; Redwood can produce the first draft and CloudMall reviews.
[23:30] Marcus Lee: timeline wise we want listing live before partner summit on May 12, so target is early May.

[27:45] Priya Kapoor: demo time — quick walkthrough of deploying a private instance: (live demo chatter, occasional pause) "deploy started" — so you'll see the control plane link, then the VPC peering step, then the KMS configuration.
[28:15] Sara Nguyen: I'm seeing a small typo in the CLI step, says `redwoo deploy` at one point in the transcript?
[28:23] Priya Kapoor: yeah sorry, that's a transcription slip, the CLI is `redwoodctl deploy` — se typo in the deck will be fixed.

[32:00] Alex Johnson: Procurement note — marketplace contracts often require indemnity and support SLA language, do you have procurement concerns?
[32:12] Marcus Lee: legal will review; for enterprise deals we prefer a standard EULA plus SOW for Dedicated customers.

[36:00] Diego Ramos: minor latency question — for customers in eu-west, can we route inference to region to meet data residency?
[36:10] Priya Kapoor: yes, smart routing supports regional routing and fallback; you can pin routes to eu-west models and we can failover to another region if needed.

[40:00] Alex Johnson: ok let's recap actions and deadlines — I'll read them out
[40:10] Alex Johnson: Redwood: draft marketplace listing + screenshot pack by 2025-04-18; Priya: reference arch + KMS flow by 2025-04-21; CloudMall: logos, SAML metadata, and SOC2 cert by 2025-04-20; schedule integration test week of 2025-04-28
[40:40] Marcus Lee: that works for us

[45:00] Priya Kapoor: one more thing — compatibility matrix for models and quantization: some enterprise customers will require FP16 vs int8 tradeoffs; we'll include recommended quant profiles per workload.
[45:20] Sara Nguyen: great, that helps our perf team plan
[46:00] Alex Johnson: cool, thanks everyone, we'll send the doc links and the draft listing after this call
[46:10] Marcus Lee: thanks all, appreciate it
[46:15] Diego Ramos: thanks, bye

End of transcript. Links shared in chat: https://redwood.ai/partner-assets/cloudmall-refarch ; https://redwood.ai/partner-assets/marketplace-checklist.pdf
